Description: "When the payment method is 'Free', all items are marked as complementary (isComplementary: true), and subtotal/discount/tax/service/extra/tip/total are all forced to 0. This ensures no revenue is recorded for free/comped orders while the order itself and stock deductions are still tracked."
Instruction: "In handleCheckout, add Free mode logic: detect if method is 'Free' (case-insensitive), override cart items to isComplementary=true, and zero out all totals."
